When you check in with yourself right now, it might be that very little registers in the physical body. At the same time, you may be carrying plain tiredness alongside the pressure you place on your own shoulders. These experiences can sit together—a sense of weariness and internal expectations, even when physical sensations remain quiet or unclear.

In noticing this, you named the possibility of giving yourself ten honest minutes of rest. Stepping back from self-imposed pressure, even for a brief pause, does not require you to figure anything out or turn your weariness into a problem to solve. 

Whether that time for rest happens today or simply stays as an open idea, offering quiet recognition to what you are holding is a gentle place to begin. What might a moment of true ease look like for you right now?
